instructions.en:
## Install {{app_name}}

Run the appropriate command in your terminal.

On Linux or macOS, run this command in Shell:

```sh
curl -fsSL '{{base_url}}{{app_path}}/install.sh' | sh
```

On Windows, run this command in PowerShell:

```powershell
irm '{{base_url}}{{app_path}}/install.ps1' | iex
```

This command downloads and runs an installer. Use a service you trust.

Installer and self-update downloads use this distribution service.

### Select a version or channel

Replace `1.2.3` with the required version. Codex supports `latest` and explicit versions; the `stable` channel is not supported.

These are alternative installation choices. Run only the command you need.

Linux / macOS — Shell

```sh
curl -fsSL '{{base_url}}{{app_path}}/install.sh' | sh -s -- --release 1.2.3
```

```sh
curl -fsSL '{{base_url}}{{app_path}}/install.sh' | sh -s -- --release latest
```

Windows — PowerShell

```powershell
& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm '{{base_url}}{{app_path}}/install.ps1'))) -Release '1.2.3'
```

```powershell
& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm '{{base_url}}{{app_path}}/install.ps1'))) -Release 'latest'
```

### Getting started

After installation, open a new terminal and run `codex`. Follow the application’s sign-in instructions.
instructions.zh-CN:
## 安装 {{app_name}}

在终端中运行适合当前系统的命令。

在 Linux 或 macOS 上，在 Shell 中运行：

```sh
curl -fsSL '{{base_url}}{{app_path}}/install.sh' | sh
```

在 Windows 上，在 PowerShell 中运行：

```powershell
irm '{{base_url}}{{app_path}}/install.ps1' | iex
```

此命令会下载并执行安装脚本，请使用你信任的服务。

安装脚本与自动更新通过此分发服务下载。

### 指定版本或通道

将 `1.2.3` 替换为需要的版本。Codex 支持 `latest` 和指定版本，不支持 `stable` 通道。

以下为不同安装选择，按需运行其中一条命令。

Linux / macOS — Shell

```sh
curl -fsSL '{{base_url}}{{app_path}}/install.sh' | sh -s -- --release 1.2.3
```

```sh
curl -fsSL '{{base_url}}{{app_path}}/install.sh' | sh -s -- --release latest
```

Windows — PowerShell

```powershell
& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm '{{base_url}}{{app_path}}/install.ps1'))) -Release '1.2.3'
```

```powershell
& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm '{{base_url}}{{app_path}}/install.ps1'))) -Release 'latest'
```

### 开始使用

安装后打开新的终端，运行 `codex`，并按照应用提示登录。

instructions.en:
## Install {{app_name}}

Run the appropriate command in your terminal.

On Linux or macOS, run this command in Shell:

```bash
curl -fsSL '{{base_url}}{{app_path}}/install.sh' | bash
```

On Windows, run this command in PowerShell:

```powershell
irm '{{base_url}}{{app_path}}/install.ps1' | iex
```

This command downloads and runs an installer. Use a service you trust.

The installer verifies the signed manifest and artifact SHA256. The managed launcher disables official automatic updates; rerun this installer to update. Running the native binary directly bypasses the launcher’s update control.

### Select a version or channel

Replace `1.2.3` with the required version; use `stable` or `latest` for a channel.

These are alternative installation choices. Run only the command you need.

Linux / macOS — Shell

```bash
curl -fsSL '{{base_url}}{{app_path}}/install.sh' | bash -s -- 1.2.3
```

```bash
curl -fsSL '{{base_url}}{{app_path}}/install.sh' | bash -s -- stable
```

```bash
curl -fsSL '{{base_url}}{{app_path}}/install.sh' | bash -s -- latest
```

Windows — PowerShell

```powershell
& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm '{{base_url}}{{app_path}}/install.ps1'))) -Target '1.2.3'
```

```powershell
& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm '{{base_url}}{{app_path}}/install.ps1'))) -Target 'stable'
```

```powershell
& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm '{{base_url}}{{app_path}}/install.ps1'))) -Target 'latest'
```

### Getting started

After installation, open a new terminal and run `claude`. Follow the application’s sign-in instructions.
